notes.title: Updated Graphics!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[list]
[*] Game has updated graphics.
[*] UI navigate buttons are now detecting what controller you're using and showing dedicated icons.
[*] More achievements added.
[*] Story presentation is improved.
[*] Small bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.content: You can unlock different achievements such as "First Customer", "First New Car", "Crazy Taxi" by doing various events in game.
